title: UN Human Rights Council Condemns Attacks on Civilians in Sudan, Calls for Immediate Truce
detail: The UN Human Rights Council formally condemned attacks on civilians in Sudan and called for an immediate truce, increasing international pressure on both the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces. The resolution signals growing global concern over the humanitarian toll of the ongoing civil war.
